load_gateway_config: load gateway configuration from config.yaml, gateway.json, and environment variables
create_GatewayConfig: create a GatewayConfig dataclass from a dictionary of platform and session settings
create_SessionResetPolicy: create a SessionResetPolicy dataclass to control when chat sessions reset by daily, idle, or both modes
